svg.title: Orin / C ratio per benchmark over time (wall-time median)
svg.desc: Small multiples, one per benchmark: the ratio of Orin (C backend) and Orin (LLVM backend) to C, by wall-time median, for every run on main. 1.0 (dashed) means as fast as C; lower is better.
svg.text: Orin / C ratio per benchmark over time (wall-time median)
